objective: Owner-requested BUKLOD Profile cover/identity layout: one-line larger display name; replace tap-photo hint with existing rank; remove default Member label; extend cover; compact and preserve actions, notes, rank and existing ads.
productionBaselineEvidence: Verified GitHub main source SHA 3b488fa704b804f05c5a289a7e0775daeabb2404 at branch creation on 2026-11-16. This is source-only, not production OTA/installed version evidence. No device, exact production manifest, or current live ad-runtime acceptance verified. Main and production OTA untouched.
chosenApproach: Edit only the existing Profile screen's hero geometry and text/layout, reuse current canonical Circle Rank and Points standings data and native photo-change control; retain existing routes, authorization, ad placements and server calls. Add accessible, responsive button geometry and focused source regression tests.
selectionRationale: Reusing the already-fetched Circle Rank and all-time rank prevents a second backend, bandwidth overhead, and stale independent state; the issue is presentational, not a finance/rank permission defect.
alternativeApproaches: Create a new Profile card and rank backend: rejected because it adds duplicate queries, auth surface and regression risk.
Hide the original avatar/photo editor or move profile actions into a drawer: rejected because it removes discoverability and changes the user's existing controls.
preserveBehaviors: Existing camera badge edits avatar, background menu edits cover, note shows up to two lines, and Edit Profile/My Note retain original routes.
Share stays prohibited for locked or unavailable profiles; default Member chip hidden without changing actual roles or privileges.
Existing monthly/all-time ranking cards, Circle Rank/character, personal posts, settings, notifications, Connect and Wall remain unchanged.
Existing AdMob inventory, ad lifecycle and dashboard navigation files remain unchanged; no new network calls or third-party dependencies.
Default/no-cover cases retain menu visibility and original non-cover top offset; dark/light theme surfaces remain contrast-safe.
acceptanceChecks: Focused Profile hero source contract test and Profile navigation/privacy regression test must pass on exact head.
Engineering Accountability, protected-feature lock and Performance QA must pass before merge.
Compile current Profile TypeScript; verify one-line name on short/long display names, font scaling and button tap targets in Android staging.
Confirm cover image, avatar camera, notes, roles, rank and all three actions in dark/light mode without blank space.
Compare current 15/30/60-minute ad/nav telemetry for exact runtime/source before any production promotion; no production OTA in this PR.
